facts: Parties: Saltash Software Ltd (Buyer), Oakhurst Holdings Ltd (Seller); the Company is Ashcombe Technologies Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 26 May 2026; Closing is scheduled for 4 August 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $3,500,000.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Calloway Robotics Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $2,880,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $98,760,000.
